items.text: In government, keeps in place the existing tax system, in which tax revenue equals about 26 percent of annual economic output, the top tax rate on earnings is about 44 percent in a typical city, counting regional and local taxes that vary by place, starting at about 9 times the average wage, and the tax rate on company profits is about 26 percent counting regional taxes.

In government, keeps in place the existing rules, in which the national minimum wage is about 24 percent of the median full-time wage, with higher minimums set by about 60 percent of regional governments, collective agreements cover about 11 percent of employees, and an employer may dismiss most employees at any time without a stated reason, notice, or severance.

items.stance: In government, enacted, with all but two of its legislators in the lower chamber and all but three in the upper chamber voting for,
In government, enacted, with all but one of its legislators in the lower chamber who voted voting for,
20 of its legislators voted for, and 195 against,

items.text: In government, its head of government ordered an end to collective bargaining at about 40 national agencies and agency units.
In government, its head of government ordered national agencies to repeal at least ten existing rules for each new rule they issue.

Its national platform, adopted before this period, pledges to make the expiring tax cuts permanent, end taxes on tips, and cut regulations. In this period it enacted versions of the first two in the budget law, the second as a temporary deduction.
